newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS CONFIRMS WANTS 51 PCT OF SIAULIU BANK.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS CONFIRMS WANTS 51 PCT OF SIAULIU BANK.

text.p: Lithuania's Hermis Bank confirmed on Wednesday that it was seeking to acquire a 51 percent stake in Siauliu Bank.
"We want to acquire 51 percent of the shares in Siauliu Bank," Vytautas Jurna, the deputy chairman of Hermis Bank's board, told Reuters.
Jurna's statement confirmed a Reuters report on Tuesday that Hermis wanted to acquire a majority stake in Siauliu Bank, one of the smallest commercial banks operating in Lithuania.
"Our application should be considered on Thursday by the Bank of Lithuania," Jurna added.
Hermis Bank is the second largest commercial bank in Lithuania.

It previously said that it was investigating the possibility of buying into other Lithuanian banks, including the state-run Agriculture Bank and State Commercial Bank, which have been slated for privatisation.
Siauliu Bank has been cited in the past by senior central bank officials as a prime contender for merger.
Analysts predict that a number of Lithuania's smaller banks will be absorbed by larger banks as they scramble to meet tough new central bank requirements.
